model: EF is referenced to VBM0,CBM=Eg. Nondegenerate mobile carriers:p=Nv*exp(-EF/kBT),n=Nc*exp(-(Eg-EF)/kBT). Dilute independent singly charged donor and acceptor defects:Dplus=Nd*exp(-(eD0+EF)/kBT),Aminus=Na*exp(-(eA0-EF)/kBT). Site densities are separate reservoirs,degeneracy factors1. These are the only charged species:charge neutrality requires p+Dplus=n+Aminus. No fixed external EF,dopant charge,other defect or additional degeneracy is allowed.
consistency_criteria: Evaluate both declared necessary working-model criteria at the solution:EF and Eg-EF must EACH be >=3*kBT,and Dplus/Nd and Aminus/Na must EACH be <=0.01. Passing these criteria is not a sufficient microscopic validation.
target: Find the self-consistent EF,return mobile densities in[n,p]order and charged-defect densities in[Dplus,Aminus]order in m^-3. Report whether all declared consistency criteria pass,and whether full charge neutrality implies n=p in this model.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled conditional material model;not a measured material claim.
